units.title: Matrices
topics: Rank by echelon and normal form
formulas: Unique solution if rank = number of unknowns
Homogeneous system AX=0 has a non-trivial solution if \operatorname{rank}(A) < n

units.title: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
formulas: Sum of eigenvalues = trace of A,\quad product of eigenvalues = |A|
Cayley-Hamilton: every square matrix satisfies its characteristic equation

units.title: Calculus
topics: Improper integrals, Beta and Gamma functions

units.title: Multivariable Calculus (Partial Differentiation and Applications)
formulas: Euler's theorem (homogeneous of degree n): x\dfrac{\partial f}{\partial x}+y\dfrac{\partial f}{\partial y} = nf
Chain rule: \dfrac{du}{dt} = \dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x}\dfrac{dx}{dt}+\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y}\dfrac{dy}{dt}
With r=f_{xx},\ s=f_{xy},\ t=f_{yy}: \text{maximum if } rt-s^2>0 \text{ and } r<0

units.title: Multivariable Calculus (Integration)
topics: Double integrals and change of order
formulas: Polar: x = r\cos\theta,\; y = r\sin\theta,\; dx\,dy = r\,dr\,d\theta
